intro.title: Card Component
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable Card component in Vue to display information like a title, description, and image in a clean, styled box. You will learn how to structure a Vue single-file component with a template, script, and style section. The core concept involves using Vue's reactive data and props to make the card content dynamic and customizable. You'll work with basic HTML structure, CSS for styling, and Vue's component system to create a modular UI element.
intro.usecase: Card components are fundamental building blocks in modern web interfaces, appearing everywhere from e-commerce product listings and social media feeds to dashboard analytics panels and content management systems. In real Vue applications, developers use cards to display user profiles, blog posts, dashboard metrics, or product items—each with consistent styling and interactive elements like buttons or hover effects. For example, an e-commerce site might use a card component to show product images, descriptions, and 'Add to Cart' buttons in a grid layout. Mastering card creation helps you build reusable, maintainable UI patterns that scale across complex applications.
